Res.Caption: Model Identifier
Res.FullDescription: The model identification that we use when providing this package to customers.

Res.Caption: Identifier
Res.FullDescription: A unique generated ID assigned to this device.

Res.Caption: Hardware ID
Res.FullDescription: A unique ID assigned to this device, usually a hardware identifier. Used for messaging and other communication needs.

Res.Caption: Kind
Res.FullDescription: The kind of device. A broad category used for messaging and communications.

Res.Caption: Description
Res.FullDescription: A description of this device and what it contains.

Res.Caption: Attached Item Type
Res.FullDescription: Specifies whether the customer has attached this device to a staff member or to a piece of equipment.

Res.Caption: Enterprise Code
Res.FullDescription: The Enterprise Code that this device has been allocated to.

Res.Caption: Server Code
Res.FullDescription: The Server Code that this device has been allocated to.

Res.Caption: Is Template
Res.FullDescription: Specifies whether this is a real device, or simply a template for a device that can be reused.
